design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., deep blue) for table headers, pull-quote border, and sidebar title.
Financials table: right-align all numeric columns; use parentheses for negative values.
Pull-quote: set in a larger serif font with a hairline rule on the left, no quotation marks.
Sidebar: set in a box with a thin border, slightly smaller font, and a ruled header.
Industry snapshot: display stats as a horizontal strip with three stat blocks, each with value and description stacked.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: The specialty chemicals segment in India (excluding agrochemicals and dyestuff) was estimated at about ₹1,000 billion in fiscal 2017, having grown at a 10–12% CAGR from fiscal 2014 to 2017.
industry_snapshot.rationale: Industry snapshot provides key market size and growth figures that are scannable and complement the prose.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: Customer concentration is notable. The top 10 customers accounted for approximately 59% of revenue from operations in FY2015, 57% in FY2016, and 59% in FY2017.
